# teams_calling_policy (Resource)

Manages the CallingPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsCallingPolicy / Get-CsTeamsCallingPolicy / Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsCallingPolicy.

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.
